properties.text: SLIDESHOW A — EXECUTIVE OPPORTUNITY / OPENING ACT, SLIDES 1–4. Slide 1 — FORMA EVERYWHERE: One creative world, every useful screen. Headline: verified sources + authored intent + many outputs + accountable human review. Speaker note: this is one coherent category, not four device apps. Slide 2 — THE PRODUCT GAP: independent equal-weight six-goal score 61.125/100 (display 61.13); phone 39.75, tablet 53.00, small monitor 67.25, large monitor 68.50, adaptive/accessibility 58.75, governed creative loop 79.50. Speaker note: strong content/governance foundation; weak attention and usability. Slide 3 — THE USER CONTRADICTION: search and Send become harder to access on the smallest screens; async events do not reliably return a person to the exact work; touch and short-height landscapes remain underserved. Slide 4 — THE DIFFERENTIATOR: one managed creative world keeps sources, document lenses, images/stories/scenes/slides/video, revisions, independent review and export traceable. Quote: “The differentiator is not that one brief can make five artifacts; it is that every artifact remains traceable, editable, reviewable, and reusable across devices.” — Product Owner.

SLIDESHOW A — AUDIENCE AND PRODUCT ARCHITECTURE, SLIDES 5–8. Slide 5 — FIVE DESTINATIONS: Projects / Work / Explore / Activity / Deliver. Projects resumes; Work makes decisions; Explore opens Library, Canvas and relevant project material; Activity groups Needs you / Ready / Updates; Deliver finishes, reviews and exports. Slide 6 — ONE PRODUCT, FOUR POSTURES: Phone = exact next action; Tablet = touch-rich exploration and two useful panes; Small/snapped monitor = complete work + one chosen pane; Large monitor = source → work → result → review relationships. Slide 7 — UNDERSTANDABLE MODES: preserve seven document views; present explicit Write / Shape / Present families without changing routes, ownership or entitlement. Slide 8 — TRUST AND ATTENTION: principal-/project-/resource-scoped Activity, exact-task deep links, actor-private job separation, independent reviewer eligibility, privacy-safe previews and no involuntary approval/spend. Exact quote: “An asynchronous job without a global, actionable inbox is just work the customer has to remember to check.” — Market Researcher.

SLIDESHOW A — INVESTMENT CASE AND DECISION, SLIDES 9–12. Slide 9 — PROVEN ASSETS: durable shared project context, seven lenses, six genuinely scoped applications, editable PPTX/DOCX with slide speaker notes, PDF exports, source-aware review, output revisions, organization retention and spending controls. Slide 10 — FIRST RELEASE, 4–6 WEEKS: visible phone Search/Send, complete collections, measured 44×44px essential targets, short-height posture, stable destinations, exact scoped Activity/review access. Slide 11 — FULL PROGRAM, 12–16 WEEKS: truth/baseline → adaptive shell → secure Activity → phone Work/Chat → Explore continuity → touch-native tablet Canvas → wide workbench/truthful collaboration → accessibility/trust evidence. Slide 12 — DECISION: invest in the adaptive product; gate unrestricted enterprise launch until independently verified identity, recovery/deletion, accessibility and permission boundaries pass. Stakeholder closers: “Every extra inch of screen should reveal a useful relationship, not another column of product chrome.” — Product Owner. “A smaller screen is not a smaller product; it is a stricter argument about what deserves the next square inch.” — Lead Designer. Authored presentation-ready narrative only; no generation, spend, publication or unsupported ROI claims.
